description: Defines the 'Value' class representing variable values in an interpreter, including types, constructors, accessors, and comparison operators.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Represents a variable value with multiple types (NONE, BOOLEAN, INTEGER, STRING, LIST, SCOPE) in the interpreter.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Constructor initializing Value with a specific type or value.

methods.name: Value(const ParseNode* origin, std::unique_ptr<Scope> scope)
methods.description: Constructor for scope type, with optional scope initialization.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operators for copying and moving Value instances.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the value.

methods.name: DescribeType
methods.description: Returns a string describing the value type.

methods.name: origin
methods.description: Returns the ParseNode that created this value.

methods.name: boolean_value
methods.description: Accesses the boolean value; DCHECK ensures type correctness.

methods.name: SetScopeValue
methods.description: Sets the scope value with a unique_ptr.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the value to a string, with optional quoting.

methods.name: VerifyTypeIs
methods.description: Checks if the value matches a specified type.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks if two Values are not equal.
